rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Hyades converts standard LaTeX math expressions into multi-line Unicode text art optimized for display in terminals, code comments, and plain text environments. Supports 95% LaTeX compatibility including fractions, roots, integrals, matrices, Greek letters, and auto-scaling delimiters. The CLI binary renders equations instantly without external dependencies, and includes an MCP server for AI assistants to generate math visualizations on demand.
